comment: Download catalog for the desktop settings window. Mirrors the two
hand-maintained Yomitan zips pinned to a DATED release URL (never
/releases/latest/) plus a byte size and SHA-256, so an install is
integrity-checked before a single row reaches the database. `family` is
the dictionary's stable title family; the installed meta name may append

entries.name: Jitendex
entries.description: The richest dictionary option and replacement for the legacy "JMdict Extra."

entries.name: KANJIDIC (English)
entries.description: Supplementary kanji dictionary for readings, meanings, JLPT grade, stroke count and frequency.
